info.title: Learning Platform API
info.description:
All responses use `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, message, errors? }`.

Authenticate with **POST /auth/login** — the browser keeps the httpOnly cookie. For API clients, copy `data.token` into **Authorize → bearerAuth**.

E401.description: Not signed in, or the session is no longer valid
